engineering_objective: Complete a production event-time session window processor so gap closes, allowed lateness, tenant isolation, watermark journaling, and restart resume agree.
native_artifact: /app/sessions output JSONL plus watermark.journal and open_sessions.json

root_cause_clusters.RC_KEY: Session identity drops tenant_id so equal user ids from different tenants share keyed state.
root_cause_clusters.RC_WM: Watermark tracking overwrites max_observed with the current event and classifies lateness after that write.
root_cause_clusters.RC_ARRIVAL: On-time gap closes use arrival index instead of event_time_ms.
root_cause_clusters.RC_JOURNAL: Watermark journal is truncated on each write with seq stuck at 1.
root_cause_clusters.RC_CLI: The CLI mutates journal and outputs before argv is parsed, and --reset-output clears the journal.
root_cause_clusters.RC_ORDER: --input tie-break and --feed file order are not honored independently of the arrival-gap path.

defects.observable_failure: acme/u1 and beta/u1 collapse into one open session.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Keying only on user_id plus a tenant column in the snapshot still lookups by user_id.

defects.observable_failure: beta event e4 appears in an acme/u1 closed session.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Filtering e4 out of acme output without changing the lookup key still merges later beta clicks.

defects.observable_failure: open_sessions.json after the basic fixture has no standalone beta/u1 in-flight session.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Writing tenant_id on the record while hashing only user_id still overwrites the slot.

defects.observable_failure: holdout other/alice is merged into hold/alice.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Special-casing the holdout tenant leaves production tenants colliding.

defects.observable_failure: A behind event after a high anchor is classified on-time because max_observed rewinds.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Clamping comparison watermark at 0 hides the rewind instead of keeping max().

defects.observable_failure: f4 is missing from late.jsonl after the late feed.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Hard-coding f4 into late.jsonl fails the next lateness probe.

defects.observable_failure: TOO_LATE watermark_ms is 0 instead of the pre-event comparison watermark.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Emitting allowed_lateness_ms as watermark_ms still fails the formula check.

defects.observable_failure: Journaled watermark_ms decreases when a late event is observed.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Sorting the journal file after the run does not restore max_observed.

defects.observable_failure: The first journal line after the late feed is the last event rather than the first observation.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Keeping only the last journal line still fails seq and prefix checks.

defects.observable_failure: acme/u1 e1/e2 never close at end_ms=35000 on --input.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Closing after a fixed number of events ignores session_gap_ms.

defects.observable_failure: Config session_gap_ms=5000 does not close between 1000 and 7000.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Changing the default gap in code and ignoring processor.json fails the next mutation.

defects.observable_failure: Holdout alice is not gap-closed at 55000.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Using processing-time sleep as a session gap is not event-time.

defects.observable_failure: --input still uses arrival-index gap even when --feed is absent.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Disabling gap entirely makes duration-only closes look right on one fixture.

defects.observable_failure: Every journal write leaves a single line with seq=1.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Incrementing seq in memory while still replacing the file loses history.

defects.observable_failure: A second run replaces the previous journal prefix.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Concatenating without monotonic seq still fails restart.

defects.observable_failure: After restart the next seq does not continue from n+1.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Loading open sessions without the journal seq restarts at 1.

defects.observable_failure: Restart overwrites earlier watermark lines instead of appending.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Copying the file aside once does not make the writer append-only.

defects.observable_failure: Unknown flags create data/watermark.journal before argparse fails.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Creating the data directory is fine; writing an empty journal is not.

defects.observable_failure: --reset-output plus an unknown flag clears an existing journal.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Rejecting unknown flags after the reset still loses the journal.

defects.observable_failure: --reset-output --empty-check truncates watermark.journal.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Skipping empty-check still wipes the journal on a real --reset-output run.

defects.observable_failure: --empty-check creates a journal file even with no observations.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Writing a zero-byte journal still fails the no-file empty-check.

defects.observable_failure: --feed of later-then-earlier timestamps treats the early event as on-time.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Sorting --feed like --input hides arrival-order lateness.

defects.observable_failure: --input of a permuted equal-time batch yields different per-user event_ids than the canonical order.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Sorting only by event_id and skipping tenant/user still permutes ties.

defects.observable_failure: A 50000ms event after a 100000ms anchor is not TOO_LATE with allowed_lateness_ms=10000.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Treating every earlier timestamp as late-allowed skips the too-late side output.

defects.observable_failure: Zero-event --input still materializes a watermark journal.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Empty-check-only guards leave --input of an empty file dirty.
